tasks.title: Config row: TIMEFRAME_CONFIG gains 30 mins -> 30 D / 30 mins
tasks.description: Add exactly one row (30 mins -> duration 30 D, bar_size 30 mins) to TIMEFRAME_CONFIG in ibkr/market_data.py, inserted between 15 mins and 1 hour so the picker (built from list(TIMEFRAME_CONFIG.keys())) orders it per A140 with no picker code change. Covers S-P12-1, D52.1, AC-D52.1 and the DG99 picker slot.
acceptance_criteria: Given TIMEFRAME_CONFIG, when read, then it contains exactly one 30 mins row mapping to duration 30 D and bar_size 30 mins, positioned between 15 mins and 1 hour.
Given the eight pre-existing TIMEFRAME_CONFIG rows, when compared, then their values and order are byte-identical to before (only one row added).

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given TIMEFRAME_CONFIG, when read, then it contains exactly one 30 mins row mapping to duration 30 D and bar_size 30 mins, positioned between 15 mins and 1 hour.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given the eight pre-existing TIMEFRAME_CONFIG rows, when compared, then their values and order are byte-identical to before (only one row added).

tasks.title: Aggregator: TIMEFRAME_SECONDS gains the 1800 key on ET half-hours
tasks.description: Add the 1800 key for 30 mins to TIMEFRAME_SECONDS in data/bar_aggregator.py; bucketing rides the existing UTC-epoch _period_start grid (no anchor-set change per S-P12-2). Buckets must open on ET clock half-hours across a DST fold with the 09:30 RTH open on a boundary, and the forming bar must aggregate into the current half-hour bucket. Covers D52.2, AC-D52.2.
acceptance_criteria: Given TIMEFRAME_SECONDS, when read, then it maps 30 mins to 1800 while the nine existing periods and the _ET_ANCHORED/_CALENDAR_BUCKETED sets are unchanged.
Given 30-minute ticks spanning a DST fold and the 09:30 RTH open, when bucketed, then every bucket opens on an ET clock half-hour (HH:00/HH:30) and 09:30 lands on a bucket boundary.
Given live ticks inside the current half-hour, when the forming bar aggregates, then it joins the current half-hour bucket (same bucket the historical bars for that half-hour land in).

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given TIMEFRAME_SECONDS, when read, then it maps 30 mins to 1800 while the nine existing periods and the _ET_ANCHORED/_CALENDAR_BUCKETED sets are unchanged.
tests.description: Assert TIMEFRAME_SECONDS['30 mins'] == 1800 and the nine existing keys plus both frozensets are unchanged.
tests.expected_result: Passes post-fix; fails pre-fix (KeyError / 300 s fallback).

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given 30-minute ticks spanning a DST fold and the 09:30 RTH open, when bucketed, then every bucket opens on an ET clock half-hour (HH:00/HH:30) and 09:30 lands on a bucket boundary.
tests.description: Red-first bucket-boundary cases over a DST-fold weekend plus the 09:30 RTH open, asserting HH:00/HH:30 ET bucket starts (parametrized over fold days). Pre-fix the unknown timeframe falls back to the 300 s grid, so boundaries fail.
tests.expected_result: Red pre-fix (300 s fallback splits half-hours); green post-fix with every asserted boundary on HH:00/HH:30 ET.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given live ticks inside the current half-hour, when the forming bar aggregates, then it joins the current half-hour bucket (same bucket the historical bars for that half-hour land in).
tests.description: Feed BarAggregator ticks for one half-hour plus a forming tick and assert the forming bar's period_start equals the historical bucket start for that half-hour.
tests.expected_result: Passes post-fix; fails pre-fix where the forming tick lands in a 5-minute bucket.

tasks.title: Planner verification + priming row + standalone IBKR probe
tasks.description: Verify (no logic change) that the planner treats 30 mins as intraday: configured-duration chunking, the AC-D16.8 floor mode-aware, bar-granular holes. Add the 30 mins row to the prime_aggregator docstring per-span table (5 secs group). Run the standalone read-only probe of the 30 mins / 30 D combo against live TWS and record it in docs/d52_probe_record.md; a 321-class rejection fails and escalates per R104, never a silent shrink. Covers S-P12-3, S-P12-5, AC-D52.3, AC-D52.6, AC-D52.7.
acceptance_criteria: Given a 30 mins load, when the planner runs, then it requests the configured duration (chunked newest-first when one window cannot cover the span), applies the AC-D16.8 floor mode-aware per AC-D16.9, and detects a hole in the middle of cached coverage at bar granularity.

Given a fresh 30 mins load mid-period, when priming runs, then it uses bar_size 5 secs with duration inside [60 S, 3600 S] (never outside that range, never the 1 min coarse branch), and the docstring per-span table names the 30 mins row in the 5 secs group.

Given live TWS, when the standalone probe issues the 30 mins / 30 D historical request, then it completes with no 321-class rejection and docs/d52_probe_record.md names the combo with a pass conclusion; a rejection fails the task and escalates instead of shrinking the duration.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given a 30 mins load, when the planner runs, then it requests the configured duration (chunked newest-first when one window cannot cover the span), applies the AC-D16.8 floor mode-aware per AC-D16.9, and detects a hole in the middle of cached coverage at bar granularity.
tests.description: Qt-free planner cases for 30 mins: full-span single chunk, wider-than-window chunking newest-first, per-mode 30-session floor session count, and hole-in-middle bar-granular detection (mirrors the D48 planner-probe structure).
tests.expected_result: Green post-fix (planner is generic); any chunking, floor, or hole-detection deviation fails.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given a fresh 30 mins load mid-period, when priming runs, then it uses bar_size 5 secs with duration inside [60 S, 3600 S] (never outside that range, never the 1 min coarse branch), and the docstring per-span table names the 30 mins row in the 5 secs group.
tests.description: Priming-shape case for a mid-period 30 mins load (elapsed span 1800 s -> 5 secs branch, duration clamped into [60 S, 3600 S]) plus a docstring assertion that the per-span table names the 30 mins row in the 5 secs group. Red-first at the table assertion (no 30 mins row pre-fix).
tests.expected_result: Red pre-fix on the table assertion; green post-fix on both shape and table.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given live TWS, when the standalone probe issues the 30 mins / 30 D historical request, then it completes with no 321-class rejection and docs/d52_probe_record.md names the combo with a pass conclusion; a rejection fails the task and escalates instead of shrinking the duration.
tests.description: Assert docs/d52_probe_record.md exists, names the (30 D, 30 mins) combo with completed bars, states no 321-class rejection, and concludes the probe gate passes (same record shape as docs/d48_probe_record.md).
tests.expected_result: Passes once the worker runs the read-only live probe and writes the record; a rejection or missing record fails.

tasks.title: Presentation inventory: picker parity, visibility guard, minutes pin
tasks.description: Verify the presentation-plane enumerations for 30 mins with no production change expected: picker lists 30 mins between 15 mins and 1 hour with select/load/persist parity; the drawing/alarm visibility dialog opens with every box default-checked and round-trips (Minutes unit row covers 30 mins, no new row); minutes_for_timeframe('30 mins') returns 30.0 via the existing secs/60 fallback. If any hardcoded enumeration misses the entry, fix it here. Covers S-P12-1 picker slot, S-P12-6, AC-D52.5 remainder, DG99.
acceptance_criteria: Given the toolbar picker, when listed, then 30 mins sits between 15 mins and 1 hour and selects, loads, and persists like every other intraday timeframe.
Given the drawing/alarm visibility dialog, when opened, then every box is default-checked and the payload round-trips with the Minutes unit row covering 30 mins (no new row, no per-timeframe key).
Given minutes_for_timeframe, when called with 30 mins, then it returns 30.0 with no new mapping line.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given the toolbar picker, when listed, then 30 mins sits between 15 mins and 1 hour and selects, loads, and persists like every other intraday timeframe.
tests.description: Picker-order case (30 mins between 15 mins and 1 hour from config order) plus a select/restore round-trip case through the persisted setting.
tests.expected_result: Green post-P12-T1; a missing or misordered entry fails.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given the drawing/alarm visibility dialog, when opened, then every box is default-checked and the payload round-trips with the Minutes unit row covering 30 mins (no new row, no per-timeframe key).
tests.description: VisibilityTab default-on guard plus get/set round-trip asserting the Minutes unit row shape is unchanged and covers 30 mins.
tests.expected_result: Green; a new row or an unchecked default fails.

tests.linked_acceptance_criterion: Given minutes_for_timeframe, when called with 30 mins, then it returns 30.0 with no new mapping line.
tests.description: Assert minutes_for_timeframe('30 mins') == 30.0 and that no explicit 30.0 mapping line exists (fallback owns it).
tests.expected_result: Green via the secs/60 fallback; any other value fails.

Given 30 mins bars, when session bands and the collapse map are built, then bands and collapse apply exactly as for the other intraday timeframes (1800 s stays intraday under the shared daily-or-coarser predicate).
